depilar_canela.prompt: The young blonde woman sits on the edge of the bed in the bright bedroom, looking down at her shin, and epilates it. Keep the pink epilator exactly as in the first frame: seen from its narrow side, it points horizontally straight into her shin, its silver epilating head pressed against the skin and its body sticking out to the right at exactly 90 degrees to the leg, held by her hand from above; the leg is vertical and the device is a horizontal bar touching it. She moves the whole epilator slowly and smoothly UPWARD along the length of her shin, from just above the ankle towards the middle of the shin, in one long continuous stroke from bottom to top, the head always touching the skin and the device always staying horizontal and perpendicular to the leg; then she lifts it off, returns to the ankle and makes a second long stroke from bottom to top. Strokes only go upward, never sideways, never downward while touching. The white cord trails down to the floor. Camera almost static, a very slow gentle movement. Her face, blonde hair and pajamas stay exactly the same. Realistic hand and skin physics, natural skin texture, calm relaxed movements. No text.

audio.script: Depilador Philips: ligar, depilar e pronto. Remove suavemente os pelos, e a depilação fica mais confortável com o uso regular.
